summary: Frontend-only testing of Lux.Sex horoscope page after redesign. All requested features verified: age gate works, zodiac-widget has no constellation background (backgroundImage=none) and follows the dark/purple page style, partners-sidebar renders alongside, 12 western + 12 chinese cards render with data-testids. Clicking sign-card-aries opens sign-horoscope-dialog with essence + all 4 sections (overview/love/career/advice), lucky numbers, Mestre Agnes badge, sign-cta and share row (WhatsApp + Copy link with 'COPIED!' feedback). AI content loads in a few seconds (no skeleton stuck). chinese-card-dragao opens chinese-zodiac-dialog with share row. Deep-link ?signo=leao auto-opens the Leão dialog with real reading. compatibility-card, personal-reading-section and agnes-login-btn present and working.

issues: Copy label renders in UPPERCASE (CSS uppercase transform) — visually 'COPIED!' instead of 'Copiado!'. Portuguese i18n key is applied but the tracking/uppercase style hides the case. Not a bug per requirement (text change verified), just visual note.
shareText is in English ('Today's reading · Mestre...') on preview build, while UI is in EN by default. If PT is expected as default, verify i18n default locale. Not blocking.
Dialog opens on top of the age gate overlay before the user accepts 18+. Consider gating dialog auto-open behind age-gate acceptance.

action_items: (Optional) Delay ZodiacWidget auto-open (?signo=/?animal=) until after age-gate acceptance to avoid showing adult horoscope content over the restricted-access screen.
(Optional) Confirm default i18n locale — WhatsApp share text renders in English on the preview.
critical_code_review_comments: ShareRow: navigator.clipboard may be undefined in insecure contexts; fallback silently swallows errors and still sets 'copied' true — acceptable UX but consider execCommand fallback.
ZodiacWidget: useEffect runs on every params change; if user navigates while dialog is open, sign state could be overwritten. Minor.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All horoscope redesign acceptance criteria are met on preview URL. Only cosmetic/optional items remain (deep-link behind age gate, i18n default). No blockers.
